newsitem.title: USA: USF&G TO ACQUIRE TITAN FOR $234 MLN.
newsitem.headline: USF&G TO ACQUIRE TITAN FOR $234 MLN.

text.p: USF&G Corp said on Friday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Titan Holdings Inc for cash and stock in a deal valued at $234 million, plus the the assumption of debt.
USF&G said the aquisition would bolster its position in two high-return specialty markets -- nonstandard auto insurance and coverage of medium-sized and smaller towns and counties.

Titan shareholders would receive $11.60 in cash and 0.46516 USF&G common shares for each Titan share, in a deal that values Titan at $23.20 per share. Titan closed Thursday at 22-14/16 in New York Stock Exchange trading.

The transaction is subject to adjustment under a collar arrangement. It was not expected to be material to the company's earnings in 1998, and would be increasingly accretive in the following years, USF&G said in a news release.
Titan, with assets of $405 million, is based in San Antonio.
USF&G said the half-cash, half-stock acquisition of Titan is not of a size that would preclude the company's further participation in the insurance industry's ongoing consolidation.
